title: Big Querying made simple
intro: This issue will deep dive into zbq or lazy bigquery which is a package I wrote a few years ago that I've been slowly improving on. The aim was to make interacting with BigQuery and GCS simpler. You'll notice that the majority of this issue is simply the deep dive, so I hope you enjoy!

title: Welcome to Snake Charmer
intro: First issue! This newsletter covers Python topics of all types on a bi-weekly (every other week) cadence. We'll review repos, packages, new python changes, and tips/tricks for different experience levels.
